own_solution.law: Energy conservation in an isolated rigid enclosure: Tf = (m1 T1 + m2 T2)/(m1 + m2); entropy generated S_gen = c [m1 ln(Tf/T1) + m2 ln(Tf/T2)]
assumptions: isolated system, no heat or work exchange
constant specific heat, negligible volume change (c_p = c_v)
both blocks uniform in temperature initially

notes: Base: Tf = 1590/5 = 318 K; S = 900 [2 ln(318/360) + 3 ln(318/290)] = 900 [2(-0.124053) + 3(0.092171)] = 900 x 0.028407 = 25.566 J/K. With 1.1 kg at 360 K added to the hotter block: Tf = (3.1 x 360 + 870)/6.1 = 325.574 K; S = 900 [3.1 ln(0.904372) + 3 ln(1.122669)] = 900 [-0.311594 + 0.347127] = 900 x 0.035532 = 31.98 J/K. Cabinet sentences are D because no heat passes between cabinet and enclosure (stated); earlier-run sentences are D. Numbered sentences all use 1.1 kg; T33C5 and TFF07 use 'a small amount' without a number.
